Title: LSJ: Two Questions (Golconda, Compel the Spirit)

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
I have two questions that I can guess the answers to, but I want to make
sure that they're right...

Golconda (or any of the other cards that now 'remove from game' instead
of burning): What happens to cards on the vampire being removed from
the game (eg skill cards, equipment, retainers)? Are they also removed
from the game, or are they burned?

Compel the Spirit: Can you play this if you discarded the ally or retainer
card? I'm not sure if it counts as being 'burned'. (I suspect that even
if it does you can't use Compel the Spirit, because it refers to a
'retainer or ally that you control', and I think you probably don't control
cards in your hand. But it's worth a shot...)

Josh

compelled Garou for free, man, that would be cool...

Messages.Author: LSJ
